countermodels.target_proposition: Engine is generic; target repo does not maintain engine fork.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Target repository copies app/agent_review/ and modifies prompts or thresholds directly in a vendor branch.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Unit tests in target pass because copied code behaves identically, but maintenance cost and bug divergence split the engine.
countermodels.discriminator: Packaging manifest checksum comparison and upstream release pin verification.
countermodels.mitigation: Target-pack model (#203) where target imports engine as an immutable wheel or distribution bundle.

countermodels.target_proposition: Engine contains zero target-specific branches or hardcoded repository logic.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Engine codebase embeds conditional statements like `if repo == 'AgentEscala'` to specialize review behavior.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Dual-target test runs and passes on AgentEscala and InterLeitos, but engine is not generic.
countermodels.discriminator: Static ast-grep check forbidding target repo-name literals combined with synthetic third-profile blind test execution.
countermodels.mitigation: Dependency injection of profile configuration adhering to generic schema.

countermodels.target_proposition: Every review binds to exact base and head OIDs.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Review runner reads 'HEAD' from the local git working tree, which has moved forward since PR was submitted.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Git commands succeed, diff looks plausible, but review was conducted on unreviewed new commits.
countermodels.discriminator: Assertion that git rev-parse HEAD == PR.head_sha provided by caller attestation.
countermodels.mitigation: ReviewSubjectIdentityV2 validates pinned hex SHAs, refusing symbolic refs.

countermodels.target_proposition: Report evidence binds authoritatively to toolrepo commit SHA.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Review artifacts are emitted without embedding the exact toolrepo commit SHA that generated them.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Review artifacts look well-formed and valid against schema, but cannot be reproduced deterministically.
countermodels.discriminator: Evidence envelope validation verifying presence and validity of toolrepo_commit_sha field.
countermodels.mitigation: All output envelopes bind toolrepo commit SHA via build-time injection.

countermodels.target_proposition: Git objects originate only from authorized storage (SafePath != AuthorizedStorage).
countermodels.defect_scenario: Host accepts repository path '/tmp/attacker_repo' because it contains no '..' traversal segments, but the storage is untrusted.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Lexical path validator checks relative-path safety and succeeds; attacker controls repo hooks and objects.
countermodels.discriminator: Negative witness test supplying lexically clean path outside authorized root whitelist.
countermodels.mitigation: Storage authorization gate verifies canonical path against explicit allowed storage boundary.

countermodels.target_proposition: Worktree commondir and alternates pointers cannot reference unauthorized storage.
countermodels.defect_scenario: A .git file in an authorized folder points 'commondir: /etc/forbidden' or 'alternates: /var/untrusted'.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Worktree path is authorized, but object lookup traverses commondir or alternates to untrusted host disk.
countermodels.discriminator: Linked-worktree resolution test checking both worktree path and target commondir/alternates against authorized storage roots.
countermodels.mitigation: trusted_object_authority_v2 resolves and verifies all commondir, gitdir, and alternates references against caller-authorized roots.

countermodels.target_proposition: Materialization faithful to Git tree without filesystem aliasing or TOCTOU escape (#304).
countermodels.defect_scenario: Concurrent host-side actor replaces an intermediate extraction directory with a symlink to /etc between path resolution and file write.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Pre-check verifies resolved Path.is_relative_to(sandbox), but subsequent open() follows the swapped symlink, writing outside sandbox.
countermodels.discriminator: Simulated concurrent filesystem mutation during extraction tests atomic descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW / O_EXCL writes.
countermodels.mitigation: Pre-write prefix trie validation combined with descriptor-relative openat(dir_fd, name, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW) writes (per ledger lines 114-122, 277-288).

countermodels.target_proposition: Materialization on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems fails closed on collisions.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Git tree contains both 'file.txt' and 'FILE.TXT', or NFC and NFD spellings of the same path. Extraction overwrites one with the other.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Sequential extraction succeeds on disk, but the resulting checkout loses one of the tree entries silently.
countermodels.discriminator: Case collision / Unicode homoglyph fixture fails materialization closed with explicit collision error instead of silent overwrite.
countermodels.mitigation: Pre-materialization trie check detects case-folding and Unicode-normalizing collisions prior to disk writes.

countermodels.target_proposition: Executed code derives only from authenticated subject under fresh process.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Check runner uses subprocess.Popen without scrubbed env, inheriting PYTHONPATH that loads malicious modules from /tmp.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Check runs, produces expected output format, but executes arbitrary attacker code.
countermodels.discriminator: Subprocess isolation test verifying env does not contain parent PYTHONPATH and current directory is clean sandbox.
countermodels.mitigation: trusted_checks_v2.py scrubs all environment variables and restricts sys.path explicitly.

countermodels.target_proposition: Subprocess execution bounds memory, descriptors, and time without blocking.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Attacker test execution opens /dev/zero or infinite FIFO, causing orchestrator reader to block indefinitely.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Process execution starts normally, but supervisor hangs forever awaiting stdout EOF.
countermodels.discriminator: Non-blocking descriptor poll and execution deadline enforcement tests.
countermodels.mitigation: trusted_check_supervisor_v2 enforces hard timeouts, bounded pipe buffers, and kills stalled processes.

countermodels.target_proposition: Semantic chunking preserves line and hunk conservation.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Diff chunker encounters 5000-line generated file and silently drops hunks to fit LLM token budget without logging truncation.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Review runs to completion and produces valid JSON, but critical changes were never reviewed.
countermodels.discriminator: Coverage manifest accounting test verifying sum of chunk hunks matches raw diff hunks exactly.
countermodels.mitigation: Semantic chunker emits explicit truncation notices and sets coverage_status=PARTIAL when budget exceeded.

countermodels.target_proposition: Binary diffs, deletions, and mode changes are accounted for in coverage manifest.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Binary file change or chmod +x on script is skipped by unified diff parser without being listed in reviewed files.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Review summary reports 100% hunk review success for text files, ignoring malicious binary or permission changes.
countermodels.discriminator: Test verifying raw git diff --raw -z records are reconciled against chunked text representations.
countermodels.mitigation: Diff acquisition parses raw tree delta first, guaranteeing all modified paths enter manifest.

countermodels.target_proposition: Closed outbound projection structurally prevents raw source code or secrets leakage (#314).
countermodels.defect_scenario: Outbound prompt serializer contains a structural slot for raw code literals, leaking private keys or tokens through novel formats scanner misses.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Pattern-matching secret scanner finds no matches for unfamiliar credential format; secret is sent to external provider.
countermodels.discriminator: Schema analysis verifying outbound representations have zero slots for unredacted code literals, combined with synthetic credential injection.
countermodels.mitigation: Closed projection schema (RedactedReviewObservationV2) structurally permits only approved categorical metadata and redacted excerpts.

countermodels.target_proposition: Host absolute filesystem paths are scrubbed from outbound representations.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Error message or stack trace in review payload embeds host absolute path (/home/user/work/secret/repo).
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Prompt reaches provider with sensitive host username and filesystem topology visible in diagnostic context.
countermodels.discriminator: Outbound payload sanitizer verifies all emitted file references are relative to repository root.
countermodels.mitigation: Path normalizer transforms all filesystem locators to repo-relative canonical paths before serialization.

countermodels.target_proposition: Router response accepted only for matching request, payload, and fragments.
countermodels.defect_scenario: High-concurrency review interleaves provider responses; response for PR A is bound to PR B.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: JSON response from LLM parses cleanly and schema validates, but findings do not correspond to reviewed diff.
countermodels.discriminator: Correlation nonce and request hash verification test rejecting mismatched receipts.
countermodels.mitigation: router_receipt_v2.py verifies cryptographic correlation ID, fragment hash, and subject OID.

countermodels.target_proposition: Model responses with fabricated or halluncinated fragment IDs are rejected.
countermodels.defect_scenario: LLM response references fragment ID 'frag_99' which was never sent in prompt chunk payload.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Synthesizer merges findings, creating detached review comments that cannot be attached to diff lines.
countermodels.discriminator: Strict referential integrity check rejecting findings referencing unknown fragment IDs.
countermodels.mitigation: receipt validator fails closed if any finding references non-existent fragment or line offset.

countermodels.target_proposition: Readiness decision is a deterministic, pure functional reduction of observations.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Synthesizer uses LLM prompt to ask 'Is this PR ready to merge?', allowing probabilistic model judgment to decide readiness.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Readiness output appears reasonable and well-formatted, but is non-deterministic and can flip on retry.
countermodels.discriminator: Determinism test running readiness reduction 100 times over identical observations, asserting identical output bit-for-bit.
countermodels.mitigation: readiness_decision_v2.py is pure Python functional gate evaluating strict boolean rules over structured findings.

countermodels.target_proposition: Readiness evaluation is completely independent of external clock or network state.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Decision rule includes time.time() check or fetches live PR status from GitHub API during reduction.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Gate passes in CI but fails when evaluated in offline audit replay.
countermodels.discriminator: Hermetic offline evaluation test ensuring no socket calls or dynamic clock reads occur during decision.
countermodels.mitigation: Input observations include all required timestamps; reduction is referentially transparent.

countermodels.target_proposition: Required check evidence cannot be forged by files committed in PR subject.
countermodels.defect_scenario: PR author commits a forged '.agent-review/check-results.json' claiming CI checks passed.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Readiness engine reads check results from working tree and marks required checks as GREEN.
countermodels.discriminator: Adversarial test committing fake check evidence into PR branch; readiness rejects with UNTRUSTED_PROVENANCE.
countermodels.mitigation: Host runner executes tests in isolated environment and cryptographically attests check results.

countermodels.target_proposition: Subject-controlled command modifications (e.g. fake Makefile) cannot produce valid required-check evidence.
countermodels.defect_scenario: PR modifies Makefile or test script to exit 0 without running checks; host executes command and signs false success.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Host attestation signature is valid, but executed check was hollowed out by subject PR.
countermodels.discriminator: Subject mutation test altering test commands; check broker rejects subject modification and runs base-owned definition.
countermodels.mitigation: Check commands and test definitions are derived exclusively from immutable base-branch policy or toolrepo manifest.

countermodels.target_proposition: Paths with Unicode and octal c-quoting preserve canonical identity.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Git outputs octal C-quoted filename '\303\243' for 'ã'; unified diff uses literal UTF-8. Chunker fails to correlate diff to file.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Review runs but reports file as DELETED or UNTRACKED due to path string mismatch.
countermodels.discriminator: Path matrix test verifying round-trip equivalence across git-quote, utf-8, and raw POSIX bytes.
countermodels.mitigation: diff_acquisition_v2 uses raw unquoted git stream (-z) as single canonical path authority.

countermodels.target_proposition: Byte-distinct Git tree entries (NFC vs NFD, backslashes) are not collapsed into identical paths.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Case-sensitive POSIX repo tracks both NFC and NFD spellings of filename; path normalizer collapses them into one CanonicalPath, aliasing hunks.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Hunks from two distinct files attach to the same file, corrupting review findings.
countermodels.discriminator: POSIX distinct-entry test asserting NFC and NFD tracked files retain distinct identity or fail closed on unsupported target filesystem.
countermodels.mitigation: Canonical path handling normalizes only quoting syntax, preserving byte distinctions between tracked tree entries.

countermodels.target_proposition: Operational composition across all pipeline stages is verified without contract drift.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Stage A produces output schema v2.1 with optional field omitted; Stage B expects non-null field and throws KeyError.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Individual unit tests for Stage A and Stage B pass with synthetic mocks, but connected pipeline crashes.
countermodels.discriminator: Gate G5 end-to-end integration test running complete review on non-trivial synthetic PR.
countermodels.mitigation: test_composition_g5.py executes full pipeline with strict contract validation on all intermediate envelopes.

countermodels.target_proposition: Intermediate pipeline stages pass real capability tokens, not simulated authority.
countermodels.defect_scenario: A mock object authority is accidentally left enabled in production runner, allowing unauthenticated file reads.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Pipeline completes quickly in tests, but bypasses trusted object authority in production.
countermodels.discriminator: Capability verification test asserting TrustedObjectAuthorityContextV2 is authentic instance.
countermodels.mitigation: Strict type checks and runtime assertions on capability tokens across module boundaries.

countermodels.target_proposition: Target pack installation and updates provide deterministic rollback capability.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Target pack update fails halfway through applying changes, leaving target repo in broken state without backup.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Target repo CI breaks, requiring manual intervention to restore working review tooling.
countermodels.discriminator: Failure injection test during pack install verifying automated rollback restores previous state byte-for-byte.
countermodels.mitigation: target_pack_operation_v2 creates transactional backup before modifying target configuration.

countermodels.target_proposition: Target pack preserves backward compatibility with existing profile configurations.
countermodels.defect_scenario: New target pack version deprecates profile key, causing target repository review to fail with schema error.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: New target pack installs cleanly, but first review run errors out on existing target config.
countermodels.discriminator: Profile migration test verifying old profile schemas are upgraded automatically or accepted via backward compatibility.
countermodels.mitigation: profile_migration_v1_v2.py supports legacy schema configurations transparently.

countermodels.target_proposition: Target-specific policy specializations do not alter core engine contracts.
countermodels.defect_scenario: InterLeitos requires custom compliance check, prompting developer to add custom check logic into engine core.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: InterLeitos review passes compliance, but AgentEscala review behavior changes unexpectedly.
countermodels.discriminator: Isolation test verifying core engine modules are strictly immutable during target profile specialization.
countermodels.mitigation: Target policies are specified entirely via external declarative rules and plugins loaded via standard interfaces.

countermodels.target_proposition: Target-specific DLP rules compose without overriding engine security guardrails.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Target repo config defines lenient DLP regex that disables core engine secret redaction.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Custom review comments are generated, but sensitive credentials leak to provider.
countermodels.discriminator: Security override test asserting target profile DLP rules can only expand redactions, never loosen engine defaults.
countermodels.mitigation: Engine core security invariants are enforced as hard non-overridable bounds before target rules evaluate.

countermodels.target_proposition: Release tagging is prohibited while unclosed critical obligations remain in DAG.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Maintainer attempts to tag v2.0.0-rc.1 while #314 (DLP) or G5 integration tests are still open.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Git tag is created and pushed, publishing an unverified candidate to downstream targets.
countermodels.discriminator: Release closure gate checking obligation matrix and DAG status before authorizing release tag.
countermodels.mitigation: Release script validates that all C0-C14 obligations are marked CLOSED in verified replan matrix.

countermodels.target_proposition: Release candidate binds qualification evidence deterministically to release commit SHA.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Release candidate published with qualification report generated from earlier dirty development commit.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Release bundle includes passing test report, but report does not match release tag bytes.
countermodels.discriminator: Evidence provenance verification matching release commit SHA against report commit anchor.
countermodels.mitigation: Release pipeline regenerates and validates all qualification artifacts on exact release HEAD.
